challenge.better_approach: Considered making recompile_gate.sh itself find the caller's checkout from $PWD instead of its own path. That changes the gate's contract for every caller (hooks and /sail call it by its own path and rely on that), so the fix stays at the three call sites. Considered a CAIRN_ROOT variable, but nothing sets it per worktree today; git rev-parse needs nothing set.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a skill is run from inside a cairn checkout. Run from the commons or outside any repo, show-toplevel names the wrong tree or fails; the command then errors 'No such file' loudly instead of writing the wrong lab, which is the Law 7 direction.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted the refreshed lab and the ticket corpus: no ticket covers the skills' house-path pin. ca9d380fe9d6 measures a linked worktree's closure at the repo's real top for the commit hook, the same move (show-toplevel) in a different component.
challenge.real_collision: none: recompile_gate.sh and the compiler are untouched; only which copy the skills name moves.

answers.falsifier: Each skill's new proof reds on origin/main (the decoy house gate answers) and greens on the build (the checkout's own gate answers). A poke from a worktree leaves the house commons' git status unchanged.
answers.how: Replace $HOME/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh at skills/intent/SKILL.md:34, skills/sorted/SKILL.md:273 and skills/design/SKILL.md:26 with "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh. Each skill gets one new proof that reads its own SKILL.md, takes the gate command it names, and runs it with bash from a scratch git checkout holding a stub gate, under a scratch HOME holding a decoy gate at dev/src/cairn; the stub must answer and the decoy must not.
answers.traces_to: RULE 1 and Law 6: a worktree's work writes only its own roots; the house commons is owned by whoever lands, and a skill fired from a worktree wrote into it.
answers.what: /intent, /sorted and /design poke the recompile gate of the cairn checkout they are run from, so a worktree's poke writes that worktree's commons lab and never the house one.

bullets.text: Three skills pin the house recompile gate, so a /sorted fired from a worktree rewrote the house commons' lab (measured 2026-11-16, the 5bb9c1c6 dirt). The same pin stands in ~40 PYTHONPATH door lines, left for a separate measurement.
